Replace the HTTP403 operator launch reference with the directly accessible original PBOC announcement; retain the original reference URL in this audit.
Distinguish settlement from invoicing, worldwide payment shares and third-country use.

Distinguish July gold trial and issuer-reported initial transactions from future formal launch; October update still describes DvP linkage in final stages.

Label COFER 2026Q2 observation versus September30 release and use consistent revised/imputed foreign-exchange denominator.
Attribute IMF constraints to staff analysis; distinguish trade-surplus funding interpretation from an accounting impossibility.
Keep oil–RMB–gold and US-inflation effects unverified; no probabilities, forecast paths or promoted monitoring indicators.
